refnamediv.refpurpose: Creates a duration from a number of seconds and nanoseconds

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
seconds
The number of whole seconds. Must be greater than or equal to 0.
nanoseconds
The fraction of a second, in nanoseconds. Must be between 0 and 999999999, inclusive.
